findings.title: The highlighted weekday bar has no stated reason

location.description: The "Downloads by weekday" bar chart, the purple Monday bar labelled 9,860.

findings.viewer_experience: One bar is picked out, but nothing says why, so a viewer cannot tell if Monday is the best day or just the one selected.

current.value: One purple bar among grey bars, with only its value above it.

findings.target: A viewer can tell from the chart alone why Monday is highlighted.
findings.fix_direction: Say in the chart what the highlight means.
findings.source: Tufte, The Visual Display of Quantitative Information

closed_when.check: Look at the chart: a label or note says why Monday is highlighted.

findings.title: Table header row barely differs from the rows below

location.description: The "Top episodes" table, the header row with Episode, Guest, Downloads, Finished.

findings.viewer_experience: Headers and values are close in size and weight, so the eye has to work to tell which is which.

current.value: Header text only slightly lighter than the values below it.

findings.target: The header row is clearly distinct from the data rows.
findings.fix_direction: Differentiate the header row from the data rows.

closed_when.check: Look at the table: the header row is clearly different from the rows below.
